headline: Bloom Secures $75 Million From Kedaara Capital to Expand Hotel Footprint
summary: Hospitality company Bloom raised $75 million in expansion funding from private equity firm Kedaara Capital. The company plans to scale its portfolio to 12,000 hotel rooms while investing in AI technology.
why: Kedaara Capital is a leading India-focused private equity firm funding tech-driven consumer brands.

impacts.name: Bloom
impacts.why: Fresh equity capital funds aggressive room expansion and technology upgrades.
